node.statement: Central tangent identity from def-approximate-unitary-space and exact unitality: the curve t maps-to exp(it)U lies in calU and has derivative iU at zero, so iU lies in T_UcalU. Complex bilinearity and U bold-dot J=U give L_U(iJ)=iU; therefore L_U^{-1}(iU)=iJ, which is anti-Hermitian because J^dagger=J, and omega_U(iU)=iJ.
